An upstream song-lane anchor now survives tight/core/full selector attempts even when Japanese singing ASR is sparse or garbled. The expanded full retry can use a uniquely supported canonical LRC plus the current audio to mint hash-bound full-song proof; ambiguity or any failed proof invariant remains fail-closed. This is a no-upload review capability, not an upload grant.

non_goals: No automatic upload was enabled by this status file.
No Bilibili publishing path may bypass AUTO_UPLOAD manifest and artifact hash gates.

This status does not claim every future live recording or every Japanese song can be processed end-to-end; it records one accepted seeded sparse-ASR no-upload song rerun plus the implemented fail-closed contracts.
Missing or ambiguous synchronized lyrics, mismatching audio, malformed evidence, or failed render proof remains fail-closed.
